answer: Every identity enters through a public inlet and pays a sybil tax, taking a pigment stamp on the ledger as its receipt. To wander past it, it must hold a current stamp: each epoch one verified work record renews it, or its 75-credit bond burns. A rented-stamp ring fails: a bought stamp never matches the buyer's work record. First 40, kth 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 75,000 locked; one honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its bond.
